newsitem.title: UK: Tesco wins British Marketing Society awards.
newsitem.headline: Tesco wins British Marketing Society awards.

text.p: British supermarket chain Tesco Plc said on Wednesday it won several awards at the annual Marketing Society Awards which recognise top business leaders, brands and companies.
The company won retail brand of the year, Tesco's marketing director Tim Mason was voted "Marketer of the year" and chairman Lord MacLaurin was appointed to the "Marketing Hall of Fame".
The awards are based on votes from 3,000 members of the Marketing Society.
